pages.text: Client tooltip names shift from blue to violet at50 energy and slowly blend when full. Maximum mastery adds a Star Sovereign prefix. Shield break briefly darkens armor names. Custom item names are respected; no name NBT is rewritten every tick. Disable names.dynamic to retain normal names. Critical highlighting remains removed.
$(bold)names.dynamic$()$(br2)Use /astral help for controls and /astral stats for counters. Restart the world after configuration changes.
